title: mariadb-operator
description: Installs mariadb-operator (upstream 26.10.2) in high availability, with its webhook certificate from cert-manager. Requires the mariadb-operator-crds Composition at the same version and cert-manager, and refuses to render without them.

global.title: Global values
global.description: Helm global values, injected when this chart is installed as a component.

preconditions.title: Preconditions
preconditions.description: enabled (default true) refuses to render while the mariadb-operator CRDs at this version or newer, or cert-manager's Certificate and Issuer CRDs, are not served. Set it false only if you manage the CRDs yourself at this version.

mariadb-operator.title: Upstream chart values
mariadb-operator.description: Passthrough to the upstream mariadb-operator chart (its values.yaml documents every key). Helm requires subchart values under a key named after the subchart and validates this schema against coalesced values that carry the subchart's full defaults, so this key is open. Keep crds.enabled false: the CRDs belong to the mariadb-operator-crds Composition.
